FREELANCE ILLUSTRATION AGREEMENT

This agreement is between Fernhollow Press LLC (“the Client”) and Mara Quillon, an independent illustrator (“the Illustrator”). It covers one project: twelve illustrations for the Client’s children’s book “The Lantern Fox.” The Client and the Illustrator are each a “party.”

1. THE WORK

1.1 The Illustrator will create twelve full-page color illustrations and one cover illustration, following the written brief the Client sent on 3 March, which is attached to this agreement.

1.2 The Illustrator will deliver rough sketches of all thirteen images by 15 April and final files by 30 June. Final files will be delivered as layered digital files at print resolution.

1.3 The Client will give one combined round of written feedback on the sketches within 10 business days of receiving them, and one round on the final files within 10 business days of receiving them. The fee includes these two rounds. Further changes are charged at the hourly rate in section 2.4, and only if both parties agree to them in writing first.

1.4 If the Client is late with feedback, the delivery dates in section 1.2 move back by the same number of days.

2. PAYMENT

2.1 The total fee for the work is $9,600.

2.2 The Client will pay the fee in three equal parts of $3,200: the first when both parties sign this agreement, the second when the Illustrator delivers the sketches, and the third when the Illustrator delivers the final files.

2.3 The Illustrator will send an invoice for each part. The Client will pay each invoice within 14 days of receiving it, by bank transfer to the account named on the invoice.

2.4 Any extra work agreed in writing under section 1.3 is paid at $60 per hour and invoiced with the next part of the fee.

2.5 The Client’s approval of the final files is not a condition of paying the third part. The third part is due once the final files match the brief and the feedback given under section 1.3.

3. RIGHTS IN THE WORK

3.1 Once the Client has paid the full fee, the Illustrator grants the Client the right to use the illustrations in all print and digital editions of “The Lantern Fox,” and in marketing for that book, anywhere in the world, for as long as the book is in print or on sale.

3.2 The Illustrator keeps ownership of the illustrations and may show them in a portfolio, on a personal website and in award entries, with credit to the Client.

3.3 The Client will credit the Illustrator by name on the cover and the title page of every edition.

3.4 If the Client wants to use the illustrations for anything else, such as merchandise or a different book, the parties will agree a separate fee in writing first.

4. THE ILLUSTRATOR’S OTHER WORK

4.1 The Illustrator is an independent business, not an employee of the Client. The Illustrator sets their own working hours and uses their own equipment.

4.2 Nothing in this agreement stops the Illustrator from working for other publishers or clients, during or after this project.

5. CONFIDENTIALITY

5.1 Each party will keep the other party’s non-public business information private, including the manuscript and the publication schedule, until the book is publicly announced. This duty does not cover information that is already public or that the law requires a party to disclose.

6. ENDING THE AGREEMENT

6.1 Either party may end this agreement at any time by giving the other party 14 days’ written notice by email.

6.2 If the agreement ends before the work is finished, the Client will pay for all work completed up to the end date. That means any part of the fee already due, plus a fair share of the next part based on the work done. The Illustrator will deliver whatever work has been completed and paid for, and the Client may use it under section 3.1.

6.3 The agreement ends automatically when the final files have been delivered and the full fee has been paid. It does not renew.

7. RESPONSIBILITY FOR LOSSES

7.1 The Illustrator confirms that the illustrations will be original work and will not copy anyone else’s work.

7.2 Each party is responsible for losses it causes the other party by breaking this agreement. Each party’s total responsibility under this agreement is limited to the total fee in section 2.1. This limit does not apply to losses caused on purpose or by fraud.

7.3 Neither party is responsible for the other party’s lost profits.

8. DISAGREEMENTS

8.1 If the parties disagree about anything in this agreement, they will first try to settle it by talking it through, by phone or video call, within 14 days of either party raising it in writing.

8.2 If that does not settle it, either party may take the matter to the courts of the state where the Illustrator lives, including small claims court.

9. GENERAL

9.1 This agreement is governed by the laws of the State of Oregon.

9.2 Any change to this agreement must be in writing and agreed by both parties by email or by signature.

9.3 This agreement and the attached brief are the whole agreement between the parties about this project.

Signed for Fernhollow Press LLC: ____________________   Date: __________

Signed by Mara Quillon: ____________________   Date: __________
